identity.title: Record evidence and projection boundary ADR

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Add an ADR that locks the architectural split between immutable source evidence, deterministic projection, governance signals, and product read models. Explicitly state that projection is disposable/rebuildable and cannot mutate source evidence. Dependency: 8001.document-everrun-dogfood-flow.
human_pressure.why_now: Without an ADR, report/dashboard work can accidentally become a second source of truth.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.

machine_core.goal: Create an accepted ADR for evidence-first deterministic read-side projection.
invariants: Depends on: 8001.document-everrun-dogfood-flow. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
contracts: Every signal/report fact can point to evidence refs.
failure_semantics: Projection failure does not mutate or invalidate stored raw evidence.

steps.title: Capture context
details: Existing EvidencePackage/RuntimeEvent/SQLite and new cross-run product needs.
Explain why direct UI/raw-event coupling is rejected.

steps.title: Record decision
details: Evidence immutable; projection deterministic; signals evidence-linked; UI read-only.

acceptance: LLM output cannot become observed fact.
No runtime-specific private format enters core.

must_check: ADR matches existing ADR-0001 and governance boundary.
Decision is narrow enough for MVP.
reject_if: ADR makes projection authoritative over evidence.
ADR introduces distributed infrastructure as current requirement.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
